components.name: Primary action link
components.description: Blue action link used in the hero and missing-page fallback.
components.html: Explore the vision
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; gap:28px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:15px 22px; font:600 14px Inter,sans-serif; color:white; text-decoration:none; background:var(--accent,#254cdc); border-radius:4px; transition:background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-primary:hover { color:white; background:#1939b0; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#254cdc); outline-offset:6px; } .ds-primary svg { flex-shrink:0; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-primary { transition:none; } }

components.name: Inverse action link
components.description: Documentation action on the dark closing background.
components.html: Read the documentation
components.css: .ds-closing { padding:28px; background:var(--ink,#151b2b); } .ds-inverse { display:inline-flex; gap:28px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:15px 22px; font:600 14px Inter,sans-serif; color:var(--ink,#151b2b); text-decoration:none; background:var(--paper,#f8f9fc); border-radius:4px; transition:background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-inverse:hover { background:#dfe5ff; } .ds-inverse:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #b7c5ff; outline-offset:6px; } .ds-inverse svg { flex-shrink:0; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-inverse { transition:none; } }

components.name: Text link
components.description: Underlined supporting navigation with an inline arrow.
components.html: See what we're building
components.css: .ds-text-link { display:inline-flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; min-height:44px; font:600 14px Inter,sans-serif; color:var(--ink,#151b2b); text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-thickness:1px; text-underline-offset:.25em; } .ds-text-link:hover { color:var(--accent,#254cdc); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#254cdc); outline-offset:6px; } .ds-text-link svg { flex-shrink:0; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Visible horizontal links that reduce spacing and type size on mobile.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:32px; align-items:center; font-family:Inter,sans-serif; color:var(--ink,#151b2b); } .ds-nav a { display:inline-flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; min-height:44px; font-size:14px; color:inherit; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:var(--accent,#254cdc); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#254cdc); outline-offset:6px; } @media(max-width:600px) { .ds-nav { gap:17px; } .ds-nav a { gap:5px; font-size:12px; } }

components.name: Tool listing
components.description: Ruled article with responsive columns; supporting link is documented separately.
components.html:
Atlas

A map of your codebase

See how a TypeScript workspace fits together. Atlas turns packages, files, and dependencies into a map you can explore in your browser.

Explore the parts.
Understand the whole.
components.css: .ds-tool { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1.4fr .7fr; gap:60px; padding-block:44px; border-top:1px solid var(--line,#d5dae5); font-family:Inter,sans-serif; color:var(--ink,#151b2b); } .ds-tool h3 { margin:0 0 10px; font-size:32px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.03em; } .ds-tool span { font-size:14px; color:var(--muted,#535d72); } .ds-tool p { margin:0; font-size:16px; line-height:1.7; color:var(--muted,#535d72); } .ds-tool .ds-detail { padding-top:7px; font-size:14px; color:var(--accent,#254cdc); } @media(max-width:900px) { .ds-tool { grid-template-columns:1fr 1.5fr; gap:40px; } .ds-tool .ds-detail { display:none; } } @media(max-width:600px) { .ds-tool { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:22px; padding-block:30px; } .ds-tool h3 { font-size:29px; } }

narrative.northStar: Deferred; no creative metaphor or permanent identity is approved.
narrative.overview:
This records the current static Astro foundation. Its colors and type are provisional implementation choices informed by the live foundry.sh reference. Brand direction and the manifesto remain deferred; no creative metaphor or permanent identity is approved here.

The implemented page uses large headings, open spacing, ruled tool listings, and a single blue accent. It introduces creation tooling broadly before presenting today's developer tools as evidence. Product scope and open decisions belong in PRODUCT.md.
keyCharacteristics: Light backgrounds with dark text and blue emphasis.
Flat sections, thin dividers, and text-led tool listings.
Self-hosted Inter with regular and semibold weights.
dos: Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.
Do use the extracted tokens for consistency while this foundation is in place.
donts: Don't treat these provisional colors, typography, or illustration as approved permanent branding.
Don't infer form, card, or application interaction patterns from this static website.
